counterfactual_missing_items: No positive epithelial marker such as keratin, pankeratin, CAM5.2, or KRT OSCAR to confirm carcinoma
No positive CDX2 to support colorectal adenocarcinoma
No positive CD117, DOG1, CD34, desmin, or SMA to support GIST
decisive_items: 6 of 14 lymph nodes positive for metastatic disease
Large fungating sigmoid mass with near-complete luminal obstruction
high-grade, poorly differentiated neoplasm with invasion through muscularis propria to serosal surface
response.rationale: R7 best fits the raw evidence by combining a sigmoid malignant mass with lymph node metastasis without overclaiming a specific histogenesis. The IHC profile is lineage-nonspecific and actually disconfirms adenocarcinoma and GIST, so R1, R2, and C1 are overcalled; C1 is also a correlated restatement of R2.

rejected.why: Undifferentiated carcinoma is not supported because epithelial markers including keratin, pankeratin, CAM5.2, and KRT OSCAR are negative; it also omits the sigmoid location and lymph node metastasis.
Adenocarcinoma is contradicted by negative CDX2 and cytokeratin markers; the raw support only establishes a poorly differentiated neoplasm.
Same adenocarcinoma overcall as R2; the append-only completion does not resolve the IHC contradiction and is a correlated restatement.
GIST is contradicted by negative CD117, DOG1, CD34, desmin, and SMA.
